description: `serve.json: {"trailingSlash": true, "cleanUrls": false}` → extensionless, non-dotfile paths get a 301 to `path + "/"`. `cleanUrls` is explicitly disabled so the cleanUrls 301 (Stage 6c) cannot mask or compose with the trailingSlash redirect. The anti-redirect anchor uses `data.txt` (extension exempt, served directly) to verify phase 5 does not fire when it should not. Backs SRV-ROUT-003.
